splits.sentence: James woke up earlier than usual because he was travelling to London that morning.
He had packed his suitcase the night before, but he still needed to check a few things.
After having breakfast, he checked his train schedule and made sure that his phone was fully charged.
He left the house at half past seven, feeling excited about the journey ahead.
James bangun lebih awal dari biasanya karena pagi itu ia akan bepergian ke London.
Ia telah mengemas kopernya malam sebelumnya, tetapi masih perlu memeriksa beberapa hal.
Setelah sarapan, ia memeriksa jadwal kereta dan memastikan ponselnya terisi penuh.
Ia meninggalkan rumah pukul setengah delapan, merasa bersemangat menghadapi perjalanan itu.
Good morning. I'd like to buy a ticket to London, please.
Could you tell me when the next train leaves?
I would prefer a direct train if there is one available.
Selamat pagi. Saya ingin membeli tiket ke London.
Bisakah Anda memberi tahu saya kapan kereta berikutnya berangkat?
Saya lebih memilih kereta langsung jika tersedia.
Certainly. The next direct train leaves at nine fifteen from platform four.
The journey usually takes about two hours, depending on the service.
Would you like a single ticket or a return ticket?
Tentu. Kereta langsung berikutnya berangkat pukul sembilan lewat lima belas dari peron empat.
Perjalanan biasanya memakan waktu sekitar dua jam, tergantung layanannya.
Apakah Anda ingin tiket sekali jalan atau pulang-pergi?
A return ticket would be better because I'm planning to come back on Sunday evening.
Could I also have a seat next to the window, if possible?
I'd like to enjoy the view during the journey.
Tiket pulang-pergi lebih baik karena saya berencana kembali pada Minggu malam.
Bisakah saya mendapatkan tempat duduk di dekat jendela, jika memungkinkan?
Saya ingin menikmati pemandangan selama perjalanan.
Of course. I've reserved a window seat for you in carriage B.
Here is your ticket, and please keep it with you until you leave the station in London.
Have a pleasant journey, and thank you for travelling with us.
Tentu. Saya telah memesan kursi dekat jendela untuk Anda di gerbong B.
Ini tiket Anda, dan mohon simpan sampai Anda meninggalkan stasiun di London.
Semoga perjalanan Anda menyenangkan, dan terima kasih telah bepergian bersama kami.
